label: Controls for the typed IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 readings
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with two beings (Bool; only true causes and is GOD_4; both have intellect and will), one respect in which everything is in act, and no potency: (1) nonvacuity: with true alone infinite and comprehending everything, both new bridges hold, and true has the nine, IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 while comprehending itself (this shows only that INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 allows self-comprehension; that it is not unknowability follows from the form of its definition); (2) with nothing infinite or IMMENSE_1: 'Whatever is IMMENSE_2 is IMMENSE_1' holds and 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is IMMENSE_1' fails; (3) with true alone infinite, everything comprehending everything and nothing INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1: 'Whatever is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1' holds and 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1' fails; (4) everything comprehends everything: the caused-is-not-infinite bridge holds, true has the nine and is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2; (5) both beings infinite, everything comprehends everything: the finite-intellect bridge holds, true has the nine and is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2; (6) sense mixing: with nothing IMMENSE_1 or INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1, true has the nine and is IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2. Statements about these interpretations only.
